change.title: npm paypal-rest-sdk (all versions, 0.x and 1.x) is deprecated; migrate to @paypal/paypal-server-sdk

source.quote: Package no longer supported. The author suggests using the @paypal/paypal-server-sdk package instead: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paypal/paypal-server-sdk.

tasks.reasoning:
package-lock.json pins paypal-rest-sdk 1.8.1, which falls in the deprecated range (<=1.8.1). npm marks the package as no longer supported and points to @paypal/paypal-server-sdk. All three call sites in routes/index.js (configure, payment.create, payment.execute) go through this SDK and the legacy v1 Payments API. The new SDK has no v1 payment.create/execute, so this is a real code migration to Orders v2, not a version bump: client construction, order creation, approval redirect, and capture on return. The new SDK is promise-based, not callback-based, so the callback-style 'error' handling must be rewritten as async/await with try/catch. Uncertain: the code scan did not read response handling, so the migration agent should inspect what the routes read from the payment response (links, transactions, amounts, payer info) and the return/cancel URL handlers, then map them to the Orders v2 response fields. Target @paypal/paypal-server-sdk >=2.0.0 and use the 2.0.0 model names, per the bundled change. Nothing breaks immediately: the deprecated SDK still runs. But it gets no security or API fixes, and payments are revenue-critical.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- paypal:server-sdk-2-0-0 (sdk-major): npm @paypal/paypal-server-sdk 2.0.0 renames models and removes shipping callback models, effective 2025-11-10. The repo does not use @paypal/paypal-server-sdk yet. The 2.0.0 model renames only matter once it adopts that SDK. The migration off paypal-rest-sdk should target @paypal/paypal-server-sdk >=2.0.0 directly and use the renamed 2.x models from the start, so no separate 1.x→2.x edit is ever needed.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paypal/PayPal-TypeScript-Server-SDK/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Several model renames for more precise mapping to controllers"

callSites.why: paypal.configure({mode, client_id, client_secret}) is the deprecated paypal-rest-sdk global config. It must become new Client({ clientCredentialsAuthCredentials: {oAuthClientId, oAuthClientSecret}, environment: Environment.Sandbox/Production }) from @paypal/paypal-server-sdk.

paypal.payment.create uses the legacy v1 Payments API through the deprecated SDK. It must move to OrdersController.createOrder (Orders v2) with intent CAPTURE, purchaseUnits and the 2.x model names. The redirect to the approval link must also be rebuilt from the order's links (rel 'approve' / 'payer-action').

paypal.payment.execute (paymentId + payer_id) has no equivalent in the new SDK. It must become OrdersController.captureOrder({ id: token }). The return-URL handler must read the 'token' query param instead of paymentId/PayerID. Error handling must change from the callback 'error' argument to try/catch on ApiError.
